GO.sargas_src: public static function pastomato_sargas( $rates, $package ) { if ( is_admin() && ! wp_doing_ajax() ) { return $rates; } $kg = 0.0; $tik_kurjeriu = false; foreach ( (array) ( $package['contents'] ?? array() ) as $eil ) { $p = $eil['data'] ?? null; if ( ! $p || ! is_a( $p, 'WC_Product' ) ) { continue; } /* v1.44 (S1601): varnele „Tik kurjeriu“ — tikrinama VISOMS eilutems, iskaitant MnM vaikus */ if ( get_post_meta( $p->get_id(), '_ps_tik_kurjeriu', true ) === 'yes' ) { $tik_kurjeriu = true; } if ( ! empty( $eil['mnm_child_id'] ) ) { continue; } /* vaikai — svorio nesidubliuoti */ $w = (float) $p->get_weight(); if ( $w > 0 ) { $kg += $w * (int) $eil['quantity']; } } if ( ! $tik_kurjeriu && $kg <= self::PASTOMATO_RIBA ) { return $rates; } $zodziai = array( 'pastomat', 'paštomat', 'terminal', 'locker', 'pickup', 'atsiemim', 'parcel' ); foreach ( $rates as $raktas => $tarifas ) { $tekstas = mb_strtolower( $raktas . ' ' . $tarifas->get_label() ); foreach ( $zodziai as $z ) { if ( mb_strpos( $tekstas, $z ) !== false ) { unset( $rates[ $raktas ] ); break; } } } return $rates; }
